Qwen38VLLoader.description: Select a local Qwen3.8 GGUF and matching vision projector. Weights load when Local Multimodal Chat · Tank runs.

model_file.name: model file (GGUF)
model_file.tooltip: Main Qwen3.8 GGUF model file. Q4_K_M is a practical starting point for 32 GB VRAM.

mmproj_file.name: projector file (mmproj)
mmproj_file.tooltip: Vision projector GGUF required to understand images and video frames.

batch_size.name: batch size
batch_size.tooltip: Number of prompt tokens processed in one llama.cpp batch. Higher can improve prompt processing speed but uses more VRAM.

micro_batch_size.name: micro batch size
micro_batch_size.tooltip: Maximum tokens processed in one physical llama.cpp sub-batch. Reduce this first if prompt processing runs out of VRAM.

gpu_layers.name: GPU layers
gpu_layers.tooltip: Number of transformer layers offloaded to the GPU. -1 offloads all layers; lower it for partial GPU offload.

free_comfy_vram.name: free ComfyUI VRAM
free_comfy_vram.tooltip: Unload ComfyUI diffusion models before loading this large local vision-language model.

0.name: model configuration
0.tooltip: Prepared model configuration; connect Local Multimodal Chat · Tank. Weights are not loaded yet.

1.name: model info
1.tooltip: Model, projector, source and recommended pair, GPU layers and loading state. Pairing information is based on filenames, not file validation.

VisionAPIEnv.description: Sends one text, image, image-batch, video-frame, or VIDEO request using an API key from an environment variable.

base_url.name: base URL
base_url.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible API base URL; do not include /chat/completions. The environment-key node only permits the administrator's host allow-list.

model.name: model ID
model.tooltip: Exact model ID exposed by the API provider.

api_key_env.name: API key environment variable
api_key_env.tooltip: Environment variable containing the API key. The request host must be administrator-allow-listed.

system_prompt.name: persona / system prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Optional persona and system-level instruction; leave blank to use the provider default.

prompt.name: user prompt
prompt.tooltip: User instruction sent to the API, together with any attached image or video input.

max_tokens.name: max output tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum output token count. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Sampling temperature. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Seed sent for sampling when the provider supports it; providers may ignore it.

thinking_mode.name: reasoning effort
thinking_mode.tooltip: Reasoning control: auto leaves the provider unchanged; off disables reasoning when supported; low, medium, high, xhigh, and max are the five unified effort tiers. A provider may reject or map unsupported tiers.

max_video_frames.name: max video frames
max_video_frames.tooltip: Sample at most this many frames from video or video frames. Every image in the image input is still sent.

video_transport.name: video transport
video_transport.tooltip: frames samples the video; video_url sends native video; auto falls back to frames only when encoding fails. Provider format support is still required.

image.name: image / image batch
image.tooltip: One still image or an IMAGE batch; every item is sent in the same API request.

video_frames.name: video frames
video_frames.tooltip: Decoded video as an IMAGE batch; frames are sampled according to max video frames.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: ComfyUI VIDEO input; use frames for broad support or video_url only when the provider supports native video.

1.name: usage
1.tooltip: Token-usage JSON returned by the provider, when available.

3.name: reasoning
3.tooltip: Reasoning text returned by the provider; empty when unavailable.

4.name: raw response
4.tooltip: Original assistant content or complete tool-call message.

VisionChat.description: One local text, image, image-batch or video request. Conversation history is not stored between runs.

backend.name: model configuration
backend.tooltip: Connect Qwen3.8 Model Loader · Tank. API Chat nodes output text directly.

system_prompt.name: persona / system prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Persona and system-level behavior or response-format instruction.

prompt.name: user prompt
prompt.tooltip: User instruction sent with the attached image or video content.

thinking_mode.name: reasoning effort
thinking_mode.tooltip: auto preserves the previous local default: thinking off. off explicitly disables thinking. Local high maps to medium and max maps to xhigh. Statistics show both selected and effective settings.

context_length.name: context length
context_length.tooltip: Local llama.cpp context window for the prompt, media tokens, and response. API backends ignore it; changing it reloads a loaded local model.

max_tokens.name: max output tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum number of new text tokens to generate. This is only a limit; generation still stops when the model finishes its answer.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Sampling randomness. Lower values are steadier; higher values are more varied. With a local model, 0 uses deterministic greedy sampling when supported.

top_p.name: top P
top_p.tooltip: Nucleus-sampling probability threshold. Lower values keep only more likely tokens; 0.95 is a strong general default.

top_k.name: top K
top_k.tooltip: For local llama.cpp, restrict each token choice to the top K candidates. 0 disables top-K filtering; API backends ignore it.

min_p.name: min P
min_p.tooltip: For local llama.cpp, discard tokens whose probability is below this fraction of the best token probability. API backends ignore it.

repeat_penalty.name: repeat penalty
repeat_penalty.tooltip: For local llama.cpp, penalize repeated text. 1.0 disables the penalty; API backends ignore it.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed for reproducible sampling when all other inputs and backend settings match. API providers may ignore it.

max_video_frames.name: max video frames
max_video_frames.tooltip: Sample at most this many frames from video or video frames. Every image in the image input is still sent.

video_transport.name: video transport
video_transport.tooltip: Compatibility option: local models always sample frames. Saved values are retained.

unload_after.name: unload after
unload_after.tooltip: Release this backend after generation. Enable to recover VRAM; disable for faster repeated chats.

image.name: image / image batch
image.tooltip: One still image or an IMAGE batch of still images.

video_frames.name: video frames
video_frames.tooltip: Decoded video frames as a ComfyUI IMAGE batch; the batch is sampled according to max video frames.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: ComfyUI VIDEO object; local models sample it into frames, while API transport follows video transport.

tools_json.name: tools JSON
tools_json.tooltip: Optional OpenAI function/tool schema as one JSON object or an array.

0.name: response
0.tooltip: Final assistant answer without hidden reasoning tags.

1.name: reasoning
1.tooltip: Reasoning text when the backend exposes it.

2.name: raw response
2.tooltip: Raw assistant content or complete tool-call message.

3.name: stats
3.tooltip: Timing, token, speed, media-count, and backend statistics.

VisionUnload.description: Release a local model. Connect the chat response to after to run after generation, or enable unload after on the chat node.

after.name: after
after.tooltip: Optional: connect the chat response to release the model after that chat completes.
